preserve_query_and_hash.fallback: default-visible recovery and noscript messages with a manual canonical link; filters and deep-link state must be reselected when the stateful link could not be initialized
preserve_query_and_hash.script_initialization_failure: recovery stays visible until the stateful link and redirect timer are ready
preserve_query_and_hash.navigation_failure: recovery is restored at the navigation attempt; the initialized manual link retains query and hash
